narrative:
FY2026 contribution is NOK 365M on NOK 6,780M of sales. Owned stores contribute 8.9% of sales (NOK 183M) and associated stores 3.8% (NOK 144M) after the store owners' share. Web shops add NOK 28M and Club & Team B2B NOK 10M.

October: sales NOK 499M, gross profit NOK 180M (36.1%), contribution NOK 29M, of which Intersport NOK 19M (66%).

signals.title: Stockouts cost NOK 23.8M of gross margin YTD
signals.source: SDP lost-sales model — POS demand vs on-shelf availability, Jan–Sep 2026
signals.excerpt: Lost sales from stockouts are NOK 64.2M YTD (NOK 23.8M gross margin): Intersport NOK 15.0M, Sport 1 NOK 6.4M, Anton Sport NOK 2.4M of margin. On-shelf availability is 93.4% against a 96% target.

signals.title: Anton Sport summer sale returned −NOK 4.1M margin ROI
signals.source: SDP Promotion ROI — campaign uplift vs markdown & media cost
signals.excerpt: Units rose 14%, but markdown depth of 40% on lifestyle footwear and NOK 2.3M of media turned the campaign margin-negative. Black Friday 2026 should cap depth at 30% on full-price lines.
